intro.text: One of the Fused, a singer who can fly, who leads Odium's forces in the field and takes a keen interest in Moash.
A high-ranking flying Fused who brought Moash over to Odium's side.
A high-ranking flying Fused who brought Moash over to Odium's side, and Kaladin's greatest rival in the skies.

items.text: Leshwi and three other Fused attacked the camp of Moash and his companions, killing the others in seconds. Moash fought her with a Shardblade, then switched to a spear; when she Lashed him into the sky he dragged her up with him and killed her with a knife. Her companions took him captive.
Her anger at Moash for killing her turned into admiration for his passion. She released him, telling him to prove himself, and was pleased when he went back to his parshman crew of his own accord.

After the battle for Kholinar, Leshwi found Moash clearing rubble. She told him he would learn in time why they were tearing down the palace, was pleased when he accepted that, and summoned him to the palace because Hnanan had a request for him.

After Moash carried out Hnanan's request, Leshwi came to him with eight other Fused and offered him Jezrien's Honorblade, warning that 'Moash' would be no more. He accepted, and she named him Vyre, 'He Who Quiets'. Moash's deeds raised her standing among the Fused, and Hnanan was proud of her choice.

Leshwi flew with the Heavenly Ones against the evacuation of Hearthstone and dueled Kaladin with a raysium spear that could draw in Stormlight. She stabbed Sigzil but spared him to repay Kaladin's mercy to one of her kind, then accepted a draw and let Kaladin go to protect civilians from Lezian.

Back in Kholinar, with Venli as her Voice, Leshwi described the Fourth Bridge to the Nine. She claimed the right to fight Kaladin over Lezian, enraging him, and disapproved of Raboniel's plan to besiege Urithiru.

Leshwi gave nearly all her servants, Venli among them, to Raboniel, ordering Venli to report on Raboniel's actions. After Urithiru fell, she took Lirin, Hesina and Oroden into her custody to protect them from Lezian. In another duel she spared Kaladin when she realised he couldn't use all his Surges.

Overjoyed when Venli revealed she was a Radiant, Leshwi said her own soul had been owned too long to bond a spren. When Lezian's troops attacked unarmed humans guarding the fallen Radiants, she ordered them to halt and then attacked them with her followers.

Lezian's troops fled, but Leshwi wanted the humans to surrender so she could explain herself to Raboniel. Rlain told her she had defied Odium and would be punished unless she fled with him, and she reluctantly agreed.

Deepest Ones and stormforms attacked Leshwi's group, and she was saved from a stormform's lightning only by Kaladin's Shardplate. When the tower's defences returned, the Fused collapsed. Leshwi woke at the Oathgate and went with Rlain and Venli's group to Narak, helping find the free listeners. She declined Kaladin's offer of a place to stay.

appearance.text: Leshwi has unusual black, white and red marbling on her face and deep ruby-red eyes. Like all Fused, she wears another singer's body, and she flies in a long red robe.
Her current body is malen; she keeps its hair long and has a barber shave away its beard, hating even faint whiskers.

personality.text: Leshwi prizes passion above all, refusing servants who lack it. She speaks her mind even to her superiors and is more open-minded than many Fused.
She sees herself as one of the few sane Fused, and chose a rank high enough that leaders defer to her but low enough that she can still fight.
She respects Kaladin as a rare challenge in the skies and will not take unfair advantage of him.
At first she valued Venli only as a servant with useful talents and treated her coldly, but warmed to her after Venli spied for her and helped protect Kaladin's family.
